name: Voorsbain
description: Voorsbain was a Mid Rim industrial planet situated in the Tangles area of the Senex sector. It was under the control of the aristocratic House Picutorion. During the Galactic Civil War, the individual Uris planned to unleash nanogene droids on the population of the planet in order to turn it into an army of mutated, zombie-like warriors.
